long_biography.plain_text:
Olav Revhaug, a Norwegian finance executive, worked at Bergerkrysset Auto from 1967. He later became finance director of Gresvig, the sporting-goods business, before taking finance roles at Brooks Sports and Resource Group International in the United States. He had studied business at the Norwegian School of Management.

In 2005, Revhaug bought B shares in TRG Holding with his own funds through his private company. The arrangement linked his returns to substantial distributions: B shareholders received dividends only once payments exceeded a specified threshold. The purchase price followed external valuations. Røkke retained all the A shares and the remaining B shares.
